original.target_description: Experiment 1 spatial-orientation performance: unresolved overall sex main effect versus sex comparisons within spatial/social conditions.

notes: Document identity verified from title, authors and DOI 10.1177/0956797616667459 in supplied canonical text. No PDF was supplied. Only assigned unfinished fields examined; other fields/sides are placeholders. Candidate tests, all p. 1511: overall sex main effect F(1, 131) = 14.22, p < .001, partial eta-squared .10, d = 0.61; spatial-condition male/female comparison t(60) = 4.83, p < .001, d = 1.15; social-condition male/female comparison t(64) = 0.01, p = .996 (no d printed for this simple comparison). The broad male-versus-female description does not identify the overall or condition-specific contrast. Candidate sample sizes from explicit final groups on p. 1508: overall factorial model 65 + 70 = 135; male-only 32 + 33 = 65; female-only 34 + 36 = 70; spatial-only 33 + 36 = 69; social-only 32 + 34 = 66. Four below-chance participants excluded before these final counts. These are candidates only; none is assigned as target analytic N. Canonical printed t(60) for the spatial sex comparison is preserved without repairing it or inferring N from df.
